utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I'll be there a bit late, got some things to sort out first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive... I'll be there too, though I might forget my tools again.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I know the feeling. I've been a bit scattered lately too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got any broken stuff for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, Leo, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead. Hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sunday at 9 too?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I'll try to pop by if my errands don't run long.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Bo! Every bit helps. Let me know if you need the address.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nah, I know where the park is. See you Saturday if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey there! Got my truck all packed with tools for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Gus! We're still short on lumber, but I heard there might be some at the old Henderson house. Want to help me check it out?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, let's go take a look. I've got some space in my truck if we find anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not yet, Faye—I've got the time and place down, but I should probably put my name on that sheet.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Eli, just a heads up—the repair drive's been moved to Sunday instead of Saturday. Make sure you sign up for the right day!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday? Oh, that throws off my schedule. I'll have to rearrange a few things, but thanks for the heads up, Mara.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, did you hear? The repair drive is finally happening this weekend — we're gonna get those old swings fixed up!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, this weekend? I thought it got moved to Sunday at the community center. Did everyone get that update?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, really? I must've missed that memo. Thanks for the heads up, Pia!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, are you free this Saturday? There's a repair drive at the community center at 9 AM!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I'll be there! I've already mapped out the houses we need to visit.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's great, Opal! Your mapping will really help us reach everyone efficiently.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, a repair drive? I think I saw a flyer about that... somewhere. Sorry, I misplaced it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries, Noah. I remember the flyer said it's this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, Saturday at 9? I thought it was 10 at the garden. Glad you remembered!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Sam, there's a repair drive this Saturday from 10 to 4. Gus is organizing it and bringing his tools. You should come.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I heard! I'm already helping Cleo sort parts for it. Count me in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, that's great! I didn't know you were helping Cleo. I'll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane! The repair drive is this Saturday at 10 AM, you should come help fix up the garden tools!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, 10 AM? I thought it was 9. I'll be there a bit late, but I'll come!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, Dane! It's definitely at 10 AM, so whenever you can make it, we'd love your help!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Jules, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at 10? I'm planning to stop by.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great to hear, Ira! I know some folks from the book club who are excited to come too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's awesome! The more help, the better. Any idea what tools we should bring?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not entirely sure, but I think it's a couple of folks from the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Is Rosa one of them?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure, I haven't heard Rosa's name mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira, are you thinking of joining us for the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You sure this repair drive is actually happening? I've heard about these things before and nothing came of it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it's definitely happening! Gus already has his truck loaded with tools, and Dane's coming too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Pia, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I'm still trying to figure out the details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, I just heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center—I'm worried not everyone will get the memo in time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sunday, huh? That's good to know. I can help spread the word to a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Bo, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up garden tools and could use your help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I'll be there. Wait, it's 9 AM, right? I almost showed up at 10. I'll bring my hammer.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Actually, it's at 10 AM, Bo! Glad you can make it—and a hammer will be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there's a repair drive happening this Saturday at 10 AM, but I'm not sure who's running it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, that's me! I'm organizing it. We're really short on lumber, so if you know anyone with spare boards, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I can ask around for lumber! Is there a specific size or type you need?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, are you free this Saturday? There's a repair drive at the community center at 9 AM!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? Oh right, the thing with Gus's tools? I think... but Saturday morning? I'll have to check my schedule—I might've promised to help Mrs. Jenkins with her fence.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the fence can wait! This is a great chance to fix things and hang out – plus we've got tons of tools from Gus.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good morning, Faye! Have you seen Rosa with the list of houses for the repair drive? I want to start mapping out the route.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Not yet, Opal. I haven't crossed paths with Rosa this morning. Want me to keep an eye out for her?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Faye! If you see her, could you send her my way? I'd like to get that list as soon as possible.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I'll be there, but I might be a bit late. Is that okay?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: No worries, I'll probably forget I'm supposed to be there too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Noah, appreciate it. I'll see you then.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll be there, Vik. Just might be a few minutes late.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries at all, Uli! The repair drive is still this Saturday at 10 AM. Hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I'll be there as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Ira, I've got my truck all loaded with tools for the repair drive this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I'll see you there at 10 AM!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, I'll be ready with anything you need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, I'll bring some spare boards from my shed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Actually, I think Rosa mentioned it's now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday. I'll adjust my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, Sunday works for me. I'll still bring the boards.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I heard it's at 9 AM Saturday at the community center. Cleo said she'll send a reminder.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect! I'll bring some lemonade to keep us refreshed. Those swings are going to be better than new!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds wonderful, Tess. I'll make sure we have a sturdy workbench set up by then.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mina! Just letting you know the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday. Hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, Sunday works for me. But why the change?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, the community center had a scheduling conflict on Saturday, so we shifted it to Sunday. Glad you can still join!
